---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL HRP == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL HRF == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL HRS == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
LOCAL HRN == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
LOCAL HRX == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems

LEMMA HRFiniteBridge ==
  \A S : /\ HRF!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
         /\ HRF!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
BY DEF HRF!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet, HRF!Cardinality, Cardinality

LEMMA HRMaximum ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW S \in SUBSET (1..n), S # {}
  PROVE /\ SetMax(S) \in S
        /\ \A k \in S : k <= SetMax(S)
<1>1. /\ S \subseteq HRX!Int
      /\ n \in HRX!Int
      /\ \A k \in S : n >= k
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. /\ HRX!Max(S) \in S
      /\ \A k \in S : HRX!Max(S) >= k
  BY <1>1, HRX!MaxIntBounded
<1>3. SetMax(S) = HRX!Max(S)
  BY DEF SetMax, HRX!Max
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRConfigIndices ==
  ASSUME NEW q, Len(q) \in Nat
  PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
        /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in 0..LastConfigIndex(q)
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) :
               k > PreviousConfigIndex(q) => k = LastConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. ConfigIndices(q) \subseteq 1..Len(q)
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>2. ConfigIndices(q) # {} =>
      /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q)) \in ConfigIndices(q)
      /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q))
  BY <1>1, HRMaximum, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} # {} =>
      /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
           \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)}
      /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
           k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
  BY <1>1, HRMaximum, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r10")
     DEF LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex

LEMMA HRSliceLength ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW a \in Nat, NEW b \in Nat
  PROVE Len(SubSeq(q,a,b)) = IF a <= b THEN b-a+1 ELSE 0
<1>1. \A k \in a..b : q[k] \in {q[j] : j \in a..b}
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, HRS!SubSeqProperties, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRAppendFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW q, Len(q) \in Nat, NEW e
  PROVE /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,e)[k] = q[k]
        /\ Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1] = e
BY HRP!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA HRConcatLength ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, Len(a) \in Nat, Len(b) \in Nat
  PROVE Len(a \o b) = Len(a) + Len(b)
BY HRP!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA HRMergeLength ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW p \in Nat, NEW es, Len(q) \in Nat, Len(es) \in Nat
  PROVE Len(MergeEntries(q,p,es)) \in Nat
<1>1. CASE Len(es) = 0
  BY <1>1, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF MergeEntries
<1>2. CASE Len(es) # 0
  <2>1. DEFINE Good(k) == p+k <= Len(q) /\ q[p+k].term = es[k].term
               Break(k) == k \in 1..(Len(es)+1) /\
                           (k = Len(es)+1 \/ ~Good(k))
  <2> HIDE DEF Good, Break
  <2>2. Break(Len(es)+1)
    BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF Break
  <2>3. PICK small \in Nat : Break(small) /\ \A j \in 0..(small-1) : ~Break(j)
    <3>1. DEFINE bad == {k \in 1..(Len(es)+1) : Break(k)}
    <3>2. bad \subseteq Nat /\ bad # {}
      BY <2>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF bad
    <3>3. /\ HRX!Min(bad) \in bad
          /\ \A j \in bad : HRX!Min(bad) <= j
      BY <3>2, HRX!MinNat
    <3>4. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF bad, Break
  <2>4. \E k \in 1..(Len(es)+1) :
            /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                  /\ p+j <= Len(q)
                  /\ q[p+j].term = es[j].term
            /\ \/ k = Len(es)+1
               \/ p+k > Len(q)
               \/ q[p+k].term # es[k].term
    BY <2>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF Break, Good
  <2>5. DEFINE first == CHOOSE k \in 1..(Len(es)+1) :
            /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                  /\ p+j <= Len(q)
                  /\ q[p+j].term = es[j].term
            /\ \/ k = Len(es)+1
               \/ p+k > Len(q)
               \/ q[p+k].term # es[k].term
  <2> HIDE DEF first
  <2>6. first \in 1..(Len(es)+1)
    BY <2>4, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF first
  <2>7. /\ Len(SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1)) \in Nat
        /\ Len(SubSeq(es,first,Len(es))) \in Nat
    <3>1. p+first-1 \in Nat /\ first \in Nat
      BY <2>6, HRP!SMTT("r5")
    <3>2. Len(SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1)) = IF 1 <= p+first-1 THEN p+first-1 ELSE 0
      BY <3>1, HRSliceLength, HRP!SMTT("r5")
    <3>3. Len(SubSeq(es,first,Len(es))) = IF first <= Len(es) THEN Len(es)-first+1 ELSE 0
      BY <3>1, HRSliceLength, HRP!SMTT("r5")
    <3>4. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, HRP!SMTT("r5")
  <2>8. Len(SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1) \o SubSeq(es,first,Len(es))) \in Nat
    BY <2>7, HRConcatLength, HRP!SMTT("r5")
  <2>9. MergeEntries(q,p,es) =
           IF first = Len(es)+1 THEN q
           ELSE SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1) \o SubSeq(es,first,Len(es))
    BY <1>2 DEF MergeEntries, first
  <2>10. QED
    BY <2>8, <2>9, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRTwoElements ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b
  PROVE IsFiniteSet({a,b}) /\ Cardinality({a,b}) <= 2
<1>1. {a,b} = {a} \cup {b}
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, HRFiniteBridge, HRF!FS_Singleton, HRFiniteBridge, HRF!FS_AddElement, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRThreeElements ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, NEW c
  PROVE IsFiniteSet({a,b,c}) /\ Cardinality({a,b,c}) <= 3
<1>1. {a,b,c} = {a,b} \cup {c}
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, HRTwoElements, HRFiniteBridge, HRF!FS_AddElement, HRF!FS_CardinalityType,
     HRP!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA HRMessageTags ==
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ AppendEntriesRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
<1>1. /\ Cardinality({RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest}) <= 3
      /\ Cardinality({RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesResponse}) <= 3
      /\ Cardinality({RequestVoteRequest, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}) <= 3
      /\ Cardinality({RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}) <= 3
  BY HRThreeElements, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. /\ (RequestVoteRequest = AppendEntriesRequest => {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse} = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesResponse})
      /\ (RequestVoteRequest = AppendEntriesResponse => {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse} = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest})
      /\ (RequestVoteResponse = AppendEntriesRequest => {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse} = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesResponse})
      /\ (RequestVoteResponse = AppendEntriesResponse => {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse} = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest})
      /\ (AppendEntriesRequest = AppendEntriesResponse => {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse} = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest})
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, MessageDomain, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRBagDomains ==
  ASSUME NEW b, NEW ms
  PROVE /\ DOMAIN (b (+) SetToBag(ms)) = DOMAIN b \cup ms
        /\ DOMAIN (b (-) SetToBag(ms)) \subseteq DOMAIN b
BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF (+), (-), SetToBag

HRMessageShape(m) ==
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesRequest =>
       /\ Len(m.mentries) \in Nat
       /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Nat
       /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat)
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesResponse => m.mmatchIndex \in Nat)

HRConfigBound(q,c,l) ==
  /\ Len(q) \in Nat
  /\ c \in Nat
  /\ l \in Nat
  /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) :
       /\ k <= l
       /\ k > c => k = l

HRConfigInv ==
  /\ log = [s \in Server |-> log[s]]
  /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ nextIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
  /\ matchIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
  /\ \A s \in Server : HRConfigBound(log[s], committedConfigIndex[s], latestConfigIndex[s])
  /\ \A m \in DOMAIN messages : HRMessageShape(m)

LEMMA HRBoundFromIndices ==
  ASSUME NEW q, Len(q) \in Nat, NEW c \in Nat,
         PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= c
  PROVE HRConfigBound(q,c,LastConfigIndex(q))
BY HRConfigIndices, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices

LEMMA HRBoundValueAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, HRConfigBound(q,c,l), NEW e,
         e.type # ConfigEntry
  PROVE HRConfigBound(Append(q,e),c,l)
BY HRAppendFacts, HRP!SMTT("r10") DEF HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices

LEMMA HRBoundConfigAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, HRConfigBound(q,c,c), NEW e
  PROVE HRConfigBound(Append(q,e),c,Len(q)+1)
BY HRAppendFacts, HRP!SMTT("r10") DEF HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices

LEMMA HRBoundCommit ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, HRConfigBound(q,c,l)
  PROVE HRConfigBound(q,l,l)
BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices

LEMMA HRInitialConfigInv == Init => HRConfigInv
BY HRS!EmptySeq, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF Init, ProtocolInit, HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices,
       HRMessageShape, EmptyBag, SetToBag

LEMMA HRConfigInvSafety == HRConfigInv => ConfigurationSafety
<1>1. ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW s \in Server
       PROVE Cardinality({k \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
                       log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry}) <= 1
  <2>0. /\ HRConfigBound(log[s],committedConfigIndex[s],latestConfigIndex[s])
        /\ commitIndex[s] \in Nat
    BY <1>1, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv
  <2>1. {k \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
                       log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry} \subseteq {latestConfigIndex[s]}
    <3>1. ASSUME NEW k \in {j \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
                       log[s][j].type = ConfigEntry}
           PROVE k = latestConfigIndex[s]
      <4>1. /\ k \in 1..Len(log[s])
            /\ log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry
            /\ k > committedConfigIndex[s]
        BY <3>1, <2>0, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigBound, Max
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1, <2>0, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigBound, ConfigIndices
    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1, HRP!SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, HRFiniteBridge, HRF!FS_Singleton, HRFiniteBridge, HRF!FS_Subset, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1 DEF ConfigurationSafety

LEMMA HRConfigInvTimeout ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, Timeout(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRMessageTags, HRBagDomains, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, Timeout, SendAll,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvLeader ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, BecomeLeader(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound
<1>2. /\ nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
      /\ matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
  BY <1>1, HRP!SMTT("r10") DEF HRConfigInv, BecomeLeader, LastLogIndex
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, BecomeLeader, logVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvPersist ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, CompletePersistVote(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRMessageTags, HRBagDomains, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, CompletePersistVote, Send,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvClient ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW v \in Values, ClientRequest(i,v)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY EntryDomain, HRBoundValueAppend, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, ClientRequest, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvPropose ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW s \in Server, ProposeConfigChange(i,s)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. DEFINE entry == [term |-> currentTerm[i], type |-> ConfigEntry,
                      config |-> IF s \in latestConfig[i] THEN latestConfig[i] \ {s}
                                 ELSE latestConfig[i] \cup {s}, value |-> Nil]
<1> HIDE DEF entry
<1>2. /\ HRConfigBound(log[i],committedConfigIndex[i],committedConfigIndex[i])
      /\ Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound, ProposeConfigChange
<1>3. /\ HRConfigBound(Append(log[i],entry),committedConfigIndex[i],Len(log[i])+1)
      /\ Len(Append(log[i],entry)) = Len(log[i])+1
  BY <1>2, HRBoundConfigAppend, HRAppendFacts, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. /\ log' = [z \in Server |-> log'[z]]
      /\ commitIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ committedConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ latestConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
      /\ matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
  <2>1. log' = [z \in Server |-> log'[z]]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>2. commitIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>3. committedConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>4. latestConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>5. nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>6. matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>5. \A z \in Server : HRConfigBound(log'[z],committedConfigIndex'[z],latestConfigIndex'[z])
  BY <1>2, <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r10") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange, entry
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, ProposeConfigChange

LEMMA HRConfigInvReplicate ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, ReplicateEntries(i,j)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. /\ Len(log[i]) \in Nat
      /\ nextIndex[i][j] \in Nat \ {0}
      /\ commitIndex[i] \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound
<1>2. Len(SubSeq(log[i],nextIndex[i][j],Len(log[i]))) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, HRSliceLength, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRMessageTags, HRBagDomains, HRS!EmptySeq, HRP!SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, ReplicateEntries, Send,
         LastLogIndex, logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvHeartbeat ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, SendHeartbeat(i,j)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRMessageTags, HRBagDomains, HRS!EmptySeq, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, SendHeartbeat, Send,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvCrash ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, Crash(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound
<1>2. /\ LastConfigIndex(log[i]) \in Nat
      /\ PreviousConfigIndex(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, HRConfigIndices, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. HRConfigBound(log[i],PreviousConfigIndex(log[i]),LastConfigIndex(log[i]))
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRBoundFromIndices, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. /\ log' = [z \in Server |-> log'[z]]
      /\ commitIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ committedConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ latestConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
      /\ nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
      /\ matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
  <2>1. log' = [z \in Server |-> log'[z]]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>2. commitIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>3. committedConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>4. latestConfigIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>5. nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat \ {0}]]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>6. matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
    BY <1>2, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>5. \A z \in Server : HRConfigBound(log'[z],committedConfigIndex'[z],latestConfigIndex'[z])
  BY <1>3, HRP!SMTT("r10") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, Crash

LEMMA HRConfigInvAdvance ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server, AdvanceCommitIndex(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. DEFINE eligible == {idx \in (commitIndex[i]+1)..LastLogIndex(i) :
                          /\ IsQuorum(({i} \cup {s \in Server : matchIndex[i][s] >= idx})
                                      \cap latestConfig[i], latestConfig[i])
                          /\ log[i][idx].term = currentTerm[i]}
<1>2. eligible # {} /\ eligible \subseteq 1..Len(log[i]) /\ Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF eligible, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex,
       HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound
<1>3. SetMax(eligible) \in Nat
  BY <1>2, HRMaximum, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>3, HRBoundCommit, HRP!SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRConfigInv, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, eligible, leaderVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvOtherLocal ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW i \in Server,
         CheckLeaderLease(i) \/ DiskBlock(i) \/ DiskUnblock(i)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRP!SMTT("r5")
   DEF HRConfigInv, CheckLeaderLease, DiskBlock, DiskUnblock,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvVoteRequest ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleRequestVoteRequest(m.mdest,m)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRMessageTags, HRBagDomains, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, HandleRequestVoteRequest, Reply, Discard,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

LEMMA HRConfigInvVoteResponse ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleRequestVoteResponse(m.mdest,m)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
BY HRBagDomains, HRP!SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRConfigInv, HandleRequestVoteResponse, Discard,
       logVars, leaderVars, configVars

HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc) == IF mc > c THEN Min(mc,Len(q)) ELSE c
HRReceivedConfig(q,cc,c) == IF LastConfigIndex(q) <= c THEN LastConfigIndex(q)
                          ELSE Max(PreviousConfigIndex(q),Min(cc,LastConfigIndex(q)))

LEMMA HRReceiveBound ==
  ASSUME NEW q, Len(q) \in Nat, NEW c \in Nat, NEW cc \in Nat, NEW mc \in Nat
  PROVE /\ HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc) \in Nat
        /\ HRReceivedConfig(q,cc,HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc)) \in Nat
        /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in Nat
        /\ HRConfigBound(q,HRReceivedConfig(q,cc,HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc)),LastConfigIndex(q))
<1>1. /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in Nat
      /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in Nat
      /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= LastConfigIndex(q)
  BY HRConfigIndices, HRP!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. /\ HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc) \in Nat
      /\ HRReceivedConfig(q,cc,HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc)) \in Nat
      /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= HRReceivedConfig(q,cc,HRReceivedCommit(q,c,mc))
  BY <1>1, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRReceivedCommit, HRReceivedConfig, Min, Max
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRBoundFromIndices, HRP!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRConfigInvAppendRequest ==
  ASSUME HRConfigInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleAppendEntriesRequest(m.mdest,m)
  PROVE HRConfigInv'
<1>1. /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Nat
      /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat
      /\ Len(m.mentries) \in Nat
  BY HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRMessageShape, HandleAppendEntriesRequest
<1>2. m.mdest \in Server => Len(MergeEntries(log[m.mdest],m.mprevLogIndex,m.mentries)) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, HRMergeLength, HRP!SMTT("r5") DEF HRConfigInv, HRConfigBound
<1>3. DEFINE qnew == MergeEntries(log[m.mdest],m.mprevLogIndex,m.mentries)
<1> HIDE DEF qnew
